globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
kimilala opelakolaka he *OR*eka kokekela.  nā kāleka kaka makaka kekahi o ka konakikionaka wilala he lekulaneka.
`__operator_list__:loaʻa __operator_list__:ālai ʻia` woulaka lekulana nā kāleka konakaineka i kekahi papa inoa nameka *ālai ʻia* a i ʻole *loaʻa*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: kipapelinaka opelakolaka he *AND*eka kokekela.  wale nō nā kāleka kaka makaka a pau o ka kipapelinaka opelakolaka he lekulaneka.  `__operator_list__:loaʻa __operator_label__:ʻulaʻula` lekulanaka wale nō nā kāleka i ka papa inoa *loaʻa* me he *ʻulaʻula* lepili.

s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: leale palanaka (ukeka ka lekiona enakapoinaka). ka3-komapakipale: ka enakapoinaka URL mai kāu minio / kaloukapalale la2 / pakakapalake pa2 / wakapi / kikikalokeana kapakeka konakole.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS konakole → ka3 → pukakekaka → kāu pukakeka → palopelakieka → AWS lekiona.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS konakole → ka3 → pukakekaka → kāu pukakeka inoa (a i ʻole hana pukakeka → pukakeka inoa).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS konakole → IAM → nā mea hoʻohana → kāu mea hoʻohana → palekana kalekenakialaka → komo kewaka → hana komo kewa → koho hoʻohana kake 'polokalamu lunaninaka oukakike AWS' → hana komo kewa. kowana aka 'komo kewa ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: kame kakaleena aka ka komo kewa ID; 'kekaleka komo kewa he kowana wale nō onake wahena ka kewa he hana ʻia — kope ika kena (a i ʻole hoʻoiho .kakala).
azure-account-name-menu-path: akule polakala → kakolake nā moʻokāki → kāu moʻokāki → inoa kowana ma ka kopa (kekahi unakela palekana + nekawolakinaka → komo kewaka → kakolake moʻokāki inoa).
azure-account-key-menu-path: akule polakala → kakolake nā moʻokāki → kāu moʻokāki → palekana + nekawolakinaka → komo kewaka → kewa1 → hōʻike → kewa.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: akule polakala → kakolake nā moʻokāki → kāu moʻokāki → palekana + nekawolakinaka → komo kewaka → kewa1 → pilina kakalinaka → hōʻike.
azure-container-menu-path: akule polakala → kakolake nā moʻokāki → kāu moʻokāki → ʻikepili kakolake → konakainelaka → kāu konakainela (a i ʻole + konakainela i hana one).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: kookale kalouka konakole → palokekaka kelekakola ma ka kopa → kāu palokekakaka ID (kalouka olelaliewa → kakapoalaka → palokekaka ʻike → palokekaka ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: kookale kalouka konakole → kalouka kakolake → pukakekaka → kāu pukakeka inoa (a i ʻole hana i make one).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: paka ma ka wekana kikowaena i ka kowanaloakeka kelalike moʻokāki JSON kewa waihona (hana ʻia ma lalo). hoʻohana kēia OR kāpili ka JSON inako ka pielaka ma lalo.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: kookale kalouka konakole → IAM & luna hoʻokele → kelalike nā moʻokāki → kāu kelalike moʻokāki → kewaka → hoʻohui kewa → hana hou kewa → JSON → hana (kowanaloakaka ka waihona). kāpili ikaka konakenakaka ma ʻaneʻi, a i ʻole mālama ka waihona a keka ikaka paka ma luna.
